name: PDP renders the correct color when navigated via ?color= query param (Pixel 7a Charcoal vs Sea)

preconditions.note: Pixel 7a variant has 3 colors and exposes them as separate catalog cards. The PDP color is driven by the ?color= URL param since all colors share a single variant slug.

steps.description: PDP shows 'Charcoal' in the variant box
Same variant slug, different color param

steps.script: (() => { const colorVal = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.vb-row')).find(r => r.querySelector('.lbl')?.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() === 'color')?.querySelector('.val')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; return { colorVal, isSea: colorVal.toLowerCase().includes('sea') }; })()
steps.description: PDP now shows 'Sea' in the variant box
Confirm catalog exposes the colors as separate cards too

steps.script: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cat-product-grid .card')); const pixel7a = cards.filter(c => /Pixel 7a/i.test(c.querySelector('.card-name')?.textContent || '')); return { pixel7aCardCount: pixel7a.length }; })()
steps.description: At least 2 separate Pixel 7a cards (one per color) visible on catalog

businessContext: A multi-color model must (a) expose each color as its own catalog card and (b) render the correct color on the PDP when navigated via ?color=. Image isolation across colors is covered by variant-image-color-isolation.
